sloka: नीलं नवभिराहत्य मैन्दं च द्विविदं तथा ।त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरमित्रघ्नस्तताप प्रवरेषुभिः ।। ६.४६.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: nīlaṁ navabhirāhatya maindaṁ ca dvividaṁ tathā ।tribhistribhiramitraghnastatāpa pravareṣubhiḥ ।। 6.46.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Indrajith endowed with great bow pierced Jambavan in his chest, and released ten arrows at Hanuman, endowed with speed in war.
